_help: Lessons for the Learn & Earn app on the TV. Edit, commit, and the TV uses it the next time the app opens. See EDITING.md. The unlock code and settings PIN are NOT in this file and must never be added here (this repo is public).

lessons.title: Backyard Squirrel Maze 1.0 - Ninja Warrior Course

questions.q: How many parts did Mark's squirrel obstacle course have?

How do squirrels survive a big fall?
answers: They flatten their body and use their tail like a parachute
They curl into a tight ball

questions.q: In the air, what does a squirrel do with its arms to spin faster?

lessons.title: How Ears Let Us Hear the World!

questions.q: What is a sound?
answers: A kind of wave that wiggles tiny particles
A tiny bug in the air

questions.q: What is the big flappy part of your ear called?
The middle ear makes sounds stronger. What is inside it?
What shape is the cochlea?
How do bats find trees and bugs in the dark?
answers: Echolocation: high sounds that bounce back

lessons.title: Can you solve the bridge riddle?

questions.q: How many people can be on the bridge at the same time?
How long until the zombies catch up?
What must anyone crossing the bridge stay next to?
The trick is that the two slowest people cross together. Who are they?
answers: The lab assistant and the janitor

lessons.title: Do we actually know how magnets work?

questions.q: What tool have people used magnets in for about a thousand years?
Which tiny particles inside atoms act like tiny magnets?
Why are most things NOT magnetic?
answers: Their electrons pair up and spin opposite ways, so they cancel out

questions.q: Which of these metals can be made into a magnet?
Which hospital machine uses magnets to see inside your body?

lessons.title: Soccer Defending: Pressure, Cover, Balance & Tackling

questions.q: In defending, what does "pressure" mean?
answers: Limiting the attacker's time and space
Kicking the ball out every time

questions.q: When you get close to the attacker, what should you do?
answers: Slow down, get low and get close

questions.q: Where should the cover defender always be?
answers: Between the ball and the goal

questions.q: Which parts of your foot can you use for a poke tackle?
answers: The inside or the outside of the foot

questions.q: In a block tackle, where do you plant your front foot?
answers: To the side of the ball, with a bent knee

lessons.title: How to Defend & Tackle in Soccer (Easy Beginner Method)

questions.q: Once you get close to the attacker, what should you do?
answers: Be more careful: bend your knees and get low

questions.q: When jockeying, how should you stand?
answers: Light on your toes, on an angle
With your back to the attacker

questions.q: What happened when the coach stood too square?
Instead of lunging for the ball, what should you do?
answers: Stay on your toes, turn, sprint and get your body in front

questions.q: When is a great time to go in for the tackle?
answers: When the attacker takes a heavy touch
As soon as the game starts
